summary: A yellow glow appears in the midst of a dark brick building. Trinity runs toward it as hard as she can, then hurls herself out into empty night space. Her body levels into a dive and she falls, arms covering her head, as the whole world seems to spin on its axis.

what_changes.before: Running across solid ground toward the lit window
what_changes.after: Hurling herself into empty space, falling in a dive
what_changes.evidence: Hurtles herself into the empty night space, her body leveling into a dive.

what_changes.before: Upright and in control of her running body
what_changes.after: Falling with the whole world spinning as she covers her head
what_changes.evidence: She falls, arms covering her head as the whole world seems to spin on its axis

event_hint.one_line: Trinity escapes the rooftop pursuit by diving out of a window into the night.

objects_that_matter: the yellow glow in the dark brick building
uncertain: Whether Trinity lands safely or is caught after the fall.
What the yellow glow signifies or where it leads her.
